run_make_gpt2_sizes: run the script to compute sizes of all numpy shard files in a given directory
build_numpy_shard_sizes: build a sizes dictionary for numpy shard files and write it to a JSON file
review_make_gpt2_sizes: review the script that scans numpy files and outputs their element counts to sizes.txt
summarize_make_gpt2_sizes: summarize the script that loads numpy files and records their flattened element sizes
test_make_gpt2_sizes: test the script by running it against a directory of numpy shard files
